descriptionChirho: A Levitical city in the territory of Benjamin, modern Jaba' northeast of Jerusalem. Mentioned as a border town in Joshua 18:24 and 21:17 (Levitical city allocation), Judges 20:10 (the Gibeah incident), 1 Samuel 13:3, 13:16, 14:5 (Philistine garrison contexts), 2 Samuel 5:25 and 1 Kings 15:22 (military actions), 1 Chronicles 6:60, 8:6 (genealogical lists), 2 Chronicles 16:6 (Asa's fortification), Ezra 2:26 and Nehemiah 7:30 (returnee lists), Isaiah 10:29 (Assyrian march route), and Zechariah 14:10 (eschatological boundary). The name appears as Geba, Geva, or Gava in English translations; all multilingual glosses (Arabic Jaba', Hindi Geba, Korean Geba) confirm a single proper noun referent regardless of prepositional context (in, from, to, and).
